package.json script 'lint' runs 'eslint .' with no --max-warnings flag, so ESLint exits non-zero on errors only and exits 0 when only warnings are present (verified with 120 pre-existing warnings exiting 0).
.github/workflows/pantheon-integration-gate.yml is unmodified and retains its own '- name: Lint' (id: lint) step and Gate 1 aggregation check.
